name: spotify-video-thumbnail
description: Video-podcast episode thumbnail for Spotify: horizontal 16:9 at the suggested 1920x1080. Brand-neutral placeholder: put the episode's real still in as the bottom image layer (fit cover, source at least 1920 px wide so nothing is upscaled), keep 2-4 big words on the side with the most empty space, and the same type and accent as the show's YouTube thumbnails. If the project already has a YouTube thumbnail spec, scale that spec's layers by 1.5 instead (1280x720 to 1920x1080).
